name: Hossein Mohammaddokht
role: DevOps | API Management & AI Platform Engineer
focus: AI Systems & Agentic AI Platform Engineering
introduction: I've spent most of my career working with Linux, networking, servers, and production systems. In recent years, my work has focused on DevOps, Kubernetes, API gateways, API management, and troubleshooting financial applications.
direction: I'm currently building AgentWallet, Atlas and Kuhban, moving toward AI Systems and Agentic AI Platform Engineering. The work covers backend services, agent workflows, APIs, testing and deployment. Some AI features are still in development or planned.

experience.summary: Working on AgentWallet, Atlas, and Kuhban, alongside their supporting infrastructure.
bullets: Working on AgentWallet, Atlas, and Kuhban, focusing on backend services, infrastructure, API design, testing, and deployment.
Setting up and maintaining Docker-based environments, databases, CI/CD workflows, and supporting services.
Working toward practical AI and agent-based features in these products.

experience.title: DevOps Engineer (API Platforms)

Maintained API management services on Kubernetes and investigated issues between gateways and backend services.
Supported financial applications, including Apache Fineract, and troubleshot Java-based services.
Tested application behavior, checked logs and API responses, and worked with developers to resolve issues.

experience.title: Technical Engineer & Help Desk
